thread:
Aisha: Heads up — onboarding report: Java README shows automatic retries but the latest JVM SDK turned retries off by default, so users get unexpected 429s and then try to add their own retry wrapper which doubles the attempts.
Aisha: Broken Java snippet in README:
```java
RedwoodClient client = RedwoodClient.create(System.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"));
chat = client.chat().create(request); // docs comment: "client retries transient errors"
```
Aisha: That comment is stale. New SDK requires an explicit RetryPolicy in the builder.
Rafael: Ugh, missed that when we released the v2 JVM client. Where is this README hosted?
Aisha: docs/onboarding/jvm/README.md lines ~12-34. Several users reported their services hitting rate limits during onboarding.
Maya: I can update the snippet to use the builder pattern and show a simple RetryPolicy example. Suggested change:
```java
RedwoodClient client = RedwoodClient.builder()
    .apiKey(System.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
    .retryPolicy(RetryPolicy.simple(3, Duration.ofMillis(500)))
    .build();
```
Maya: Also add a note that the CLI and curl examples use `--api-key` flag which doesn't exist anymore; prefer env var or `Authorization: Bearer` header.
sdk-bot: Snapshot test failure: README jvm snippet mismatch with sdk v2.1.0 API shape. Rule ID: sdk-jvm-compat-2026-03. Auto-filed by snippet-linter.
QA: I've seen support tickets where users copied the old snippet and then wrapped their own retries. We should call out "do not wrap SDK retries" once we confirm default behavior. But here default is OFF so call out how to enable it.
Rafael: Plan: (1) Update README snippet to new builder + explicit RetryPolicy, (2) remove stale comment about auto-retry, (3) normalize examples to use REDWOOD_API_KEY env var and Bearer header, (4) add a smoke snippet test to samples CI that checks for deprecated constructor usage.
Kendall: I'll open a small PR for the README and the samples linter rule to flag `RedwoodClient.create(` constructor usage. Links when ready.
Maya: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/834 - changes jvm README, adds retry example, and updates CLI/curl examples.
Aisha: Nice. Can we also add a short migration note in the SDK changelog so folks searching for errors find the guidance?
Rafael: Yes, I'll add a changelog entry and a one-line migration guide in the JVM SDK repo.
sdk-bot: Docs preview for PR #834: https://docs.redwood.ai/pr-834 - snippet linter flags cleared after update. :white_check_mark:
Aisha: Sweet. Once PR merges let's ping support so they can close the related tickets. Thanks all for the quick patch. :rocket:
